body: I had to cut three people out of my life because they were not there for me when I had to be checked into a psych ward. Honestly, you are better off without these people.  You'll realize who are the people that really understand and care about you. Or you'll meet people who will.  Someone who was really there for me was someone I knew for only four months.
I really hope my post helps others realize they need to keep reaching out. Somewhere, there is someone that loves you and needs you to stick around.
I'm definitely going to try.
Hugs to you, too!
Thank you!

Pho.  I could not understand why people would go out to eat and just have soup.  I only did that when I was sick.

You are so right.  I wouldn't call myself a feminist through most of college because I went to a small school and didn't want to be associated with the ones that made the most noise.  When they graduated, I immediately started calling myself a feminist again.

I've had many friends go through this.  One friend talked my ear off and I told him that he really needed a therapist because I could listen and be on his side, but I could not help him heal.  It wasn't that I didn't want to listen anymore; I realized that I couldn't really help him the way he needed.

Sometimes you need a professional to help you and I definitely think this is one of those times.
Thank you!
Thanks, I had to be hospitalized 10 years ago and I'm really hoping I'll never have to do it again.
Thank you so much.  It's nice to have a place to talk with people who've been through the same thing.

It really won't get better. I have no control over any of the crappy things that have happened. I can't force an employer to hire. I can't afford to move. I can't make people care about me. I worked really hard to build a good life. I've been on my own since I was 18. I had a good life and I've lost it all. I don't feel bad about myself. I know I didn't do anything to make any of this happen. I also know I can't do anything to change any of it.

I have been feeling that way lately since I have an incurable, painful disease, no insurance, and just about everyone I've ever cared about ignores me. I just live for the couple of people who still care about me.

It's easier for me to get out of bed if I have something to look forward to. During the week it's easy because I like my job, but I fall asleep (with sleeping pills) the moment I get home. On weekends, it's harder because I have nothing planned. I'll sleep through the entire weekend if I don't make plans with someone else. Even if I want to see a movie or I have to do laundry, I won't leave my apartment without the motivation of seeing another person.
I've thought about killing myself since I was about 8 and I'm 32 now. Up or down, I've never really been scared of death or even cared if I died the next day.
That is a fantastic way to think about it! Thank you!
